alternative_1876.edition: Crítica del Juicio, Madrid: Iravedra y Novo, 1876, translated by Alejo García Moreno and Juan Ruvira through the French translation of Jules Barni.
alternative_1876.note: Research reader located institutional transcription covering relevant sections; its reuse terms need separate assessment. Google catalog identifies a scan of volume I but actual images could not be accessed. In §48 the transcription renders German innern Bestimmung as destino ulterior; examine Spanish and French print before concluding where the difference originates. Ruvira dates unknown; sources conflict on García Moreno death. This is a different translation from Morente 1914, not a substitute under his name.
